description: The committed definition of one fkf base. It holds no secret.

bin.description: Absolute or ~-relative machine-local directories outside the base, prepended to PATH for every declared command. Put base-controlled executables in <base>/bin so trust hashes them.

fkf.description: Configuration contract marker. v1 accepts exactly fkf: 1.

layers.description: Explicit activation. A disabled layer is not created, listed, served, or scanned.

projects.description: Intent and decisions over weeks (Markdown, status-bearing).

name.description: MCP server name and resource URI authority; informational elsewhere.

cardinality.description: Allowed scalar count per record or explicit Markdown relation list.

description.description: Shared human and machine meaning of this field across sources and authored relations.

examples.description: Bounded examples that clarify the semantic value or URI shape.

relation.description: Values are canonical fkf URIs transcribed as graph edges of this field name.

schema.description: Open semantic dictionary shared by every source and authored relation. id must have cardinality one; fkf enforces cross-field rules while loading.

body.description: Argv (never a shell string) fetching one record's body on demand. Must name {{id}} and may name any declared field plus {{base}} or {{home}}.

prefixItems.description: Literal executable: a bare name resolved on PATH or an absolute machine-local path outside the base. Placeholders and base-relative paths are refused.

enabled.description: Whether sync runs this source. Disabled entries are still validated.

oneOf.description: A declared semantic projection indexed for lexical context; every path contributes scalar values. A jq subset: .key, .a.b, [n], [], ."odd key".

items.description: A declared semantic projection indexed for lexical context; every path contributes scalar values. A jq subset: .key, .a.b, [n], [], ."odd key".

fields.description: Associates root schema names with provider paths. id and event time are required; every declared value is indexed lexically and relation fields are transcribed into the graph.

oneOf.description: Required. Exactly one scalar is the record identity that its URI fragment names. A jq subset: .key, .a.b, [n], [], ."odd key".

items.description: Required. Exactly one scalar is the record identity that its URI fragment names. A jq subset: .key, .a.b, [n], [], ."odd key".

oneOf.description: Required for an events source. Exactly one scalar is the record timestamp. A jq subset: .key, .a.b, [n], [], ."odd key".

items.description: Required for an events source. Exactly one scalar is the record timestamp. A jq subset: .key, .a.b, [n], [], ."odd key".

oneOf.description: Suggested human-readable label; at most one scalar. A jq subset: .key, .a.b, [n], [], ."odd key".

items.description: Suggested human-readable label; at most one scalar. A jq subset: .key, .a.b, [n], [], ."odd key".

oneOf.description: Suggested provider URL; at most one scalar. A jq subset: .key, .a.b, [n], [], ."odd key".

items.description: Suggested provider URL; at most one scalar. A jq subset: .key, .a.b, [n], [], ."odd key".

format.description: json expects one document; ndjson expects one JSON value per line.

install.description: Printed by `fkf status` when the binary is missing. Never executed.

layer.description: events files one document per day under events/; index files one point-in-time document under index/.

min_interval.description: Least time between two invocations of THIS source across the whole sync. Retry spaces the attempts of one failing call; this spaces every call, which is what a provider's rate limit actually counts.

records.description: Path to the records inside each decoded document or page. A jq subset: .key, .a.b, [n], [], ."odd key".

requires.description: Executable names fkf status checks on PATH, including helpers and non-standard interpreters. FKF never infers dependencies from argv or helper contents.

retry.description: How fkf re-invokes this command, never what it is — the same relationship `timeout:` has to `run:`. `fkf trust` prints it beside the line it modifies.

attempts.description: Total runs allowed, including the first.

backoff.description: Wait before the next attempt, growing linearly with the attempt number.

on.description: Which failures may be retried: `exit:<n>`, or a substring matched against the command's stderr. Required whenever attempts exceeds one — retrying every failure is how a source failing for a real reason hammers a provider quietly. The matched text is never logged or stored.

run.description: Direct argv producing JSON; no shell parses it. A helper shebang selects its interpreter. Argument placeholders: {{date}}, {{next_date}}, {{start}}, {{end}}, {{base}}, {{home}}. No collected data is ever substituted.

prefixItems.description: Literal executable: a bare name resolved on PATH or an absolute machine-local path outside the base.

window.description: Render run: ONCE for the whole requested range — {{start}}/{{end}} span every day being collected, not one — and bucket the records it returns into one document per day by each record's own declared fields.time. Only an events source may declare it: a whole-range collection buckets by day, and an index source has no day.

days.description: Completed local days to collect when no --date is given.

index_max_age_hours.description: Refresh an index document only when it is older than this; 1..87600.
